anomalies.observed: U1 (MAX3485) is assigned footprint Package_SO:SO-8_5.3x6.2mm_P1.27mm, a wide-body SO-8 land pattern.
anomalies.expected: The MAX3485 datasheet and the symbol's own footprint filters specify an 8-SOIC narrow package (3.9 x 4.9 mm, 1.27 mm pitch) or DIP-8. The footprint should be the matching narrow SOIC-8 land pattern, e.g. Package_SO:SO-8_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm.
anomalies.impact: The MAX3485 in its actual 8-SOIC narrow package will not fit the wider SO-8 pads, so the serial servo transceiver cannot be assembled reliably and the serial servo interface will be nonfunctional.

parsed.summary: The design has a U1 footprint mismatch: the MAX3485 is assigned a 5.3x6.2 mm wide SO-8 footprint even though its datasheet and library filters require a 3.9x4.9 mm narrow SOIC-8 footprint, preventing proper assembly of the serial servo transceiver.
